projects.title: Meeting Experience Application Platform
projects.description:
•	A combination of client-side (using AngularJS framework) and server-side (based on NodeJS) components, it serves and manages the ensemble of modules driving meeting experience of Polycom’s Real Presence Web Suite users.
•	A gateway that handles client authentication, communication with other server components and rules based meeting management features viz., roster list permissions, chat, content and screen share permissions etc.
•	Optimized user experience with minimal latency and pronounced stability is one of the key aspects addressed by this system
